quote: Weatherford International plc (NASDAQ: WFRD) ("Weatherford" or the "Company") today announced it has been awarded a significant contract to deliver Managed Pressure Drilling (MPD) services for the Trion project, a deepwater oil production project in Mexico ... initial 8 wells with the potential to expand to 24 wells.
note: Opened Weatherford English IR news article 28 Jul 2025.
